verdict.rationale: Neon documents built-in connection pooling (PgBouncer-based, per Neon's docs) as a standard feature (neon-docs-13/30), so platform engineers do not need to run their own pooler/proxy; this is reinforced by the serverless driver and autoscaling docs which imply high concurrent connection handling without external infra. missing for 10: no explicit numeric concurrency benchmarks (e.g., 'thousands of connections') and no independent/hands-on report validating pooling behavior under load.
